notes.title: Update V0.0.0.2: Fixes and Feedbacks
notes.notes:
[h1]Game Balance Improvements and Optimization Improvements[/h1]

We hear your feedbacks and made some changes.

[h3]Game Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Holy Cross spawn count increased and respawn time reduced.
[*]Fastest Monster slightly slowed down.
[*]The final phase of the Monster has been placed slightly forward.
[/list]

[h3]Optimization Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Sudden FPS Drops fixed. 
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Some localization errors fixed.
[*]Fixed some visual bugs in the UI
[/list]
